# Neuron Guide

> AI tools directory to discover, compare, and master 500+ AI tools across 21+ categories for productivity, creativity, and growth.

Neuron Guide helps people find the right AI tool fast. Browse a categorized directory, compare features, read usage analytics, and chat with an AI study/assistant.

## Pages

- [Welcome](/welcome): Landing page introducing Neuron Guide and its features.
- [Home](/home): Main hub with search, featured AI tools, and stats.
- [Tools](/tools): Full directory of 500+ AI tools across 21+ categories.
- [How it works](/how-it-works): 3-step guide to browsing, comparing, and using AI tools.
- [Tutorials](/tutorials): Video tutorials for getting started with popular AI tools.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Pro plan at $5/month with full access.
- [AI Assistant](/chatbot): Academic-focused AI chatbot with study and exam modes.

## Optional

- [Analytics](/analytics): Usage trends and engagement charts for AI tools.
